# Speculation Clock Registry

This registry extends the evidence-fed clock system with claim monitors derived from the Dark Speculation research page.

Rules:
- percentages are evidence-pressure or claim-support indexes, not event probability;
- public-record-adjacent lanes may move only on dated source-linked mechanisms;
- mythology, paranormal and extreme-allegation lanes begin low and require authenticated primary evidence to rise;
- counter-sources, corrections, failed provenance and court rejection lower the index;
- no clock may convert symbolism, association or internet repetition into an accusation against a real person;
- every clock remains excluded from the homepage critical-clock surface unless separately approved.
